item.title: DJ Snake to Headline Sunburn Festival 2026 in Mumbai
item.dc:creator: Anurag Tagat
item.content:encoded:
French DJ-producer DJ Snake will make his long-anticipated return to India this December, as the third headliner at Sunburn Festival held at Mahalaxmi Racecourse in Mumbai between Dec. 18 and 19, 2026.

The “Lean On” and “Taki Taki” hitmaker performs on Dec. 19, 2026 and joins the lineup to headline alongside artists such as American EDM duo The Chainsmokers and Swedish artist Sebastian Ingrosso from acclaimed EDM group Swedish House Mafia. The festival moved from its original Goa home to Mumbai last year, being held at Infinity Bay in Sewri. Now, it moves further into the city at Mahalaxmi Racecourse, which also hosts festivals such as Lollapalooza India.

DJ Snake aka William Grigahcine says in a statement, “India always brings incredible energy and I’m really looking forward to returning here. I can’t wait to get back on that stage and celebrate with everyone.”

The “Magenta Riddim” artist was originally scheduled to perform in six cities as part of a Sunburn Arena tour last year, but the shows were postponed citing production and logistical issues. The subsequently announced February 2026 dates were canceled owing to health concerns. Rescheduled dates include Dec. 18, 2026 in Bengaluru, among those announced so far.

No stranger to India, DJ Snake has performed across the country a few times over, most recently in 2022. He last performed at Sunburn Festival in 2019.

Sunburn CEO Karan Singh says in his statement, “DJ Snake has always shared a special connection with Indian audiences and his multiple visits to the country over the years are a testament to that enduring bond. We’re thrilled to welcome him back to India and bring him to Mumbai as part of Sunburn Festival 2026, giving fans an opportunity to experience one of the world’s most celebrated electronic artists on an even bigger stage. With The Chainsmokers, Sebastian Ingrosso and now DJ Snake, this edition brings together artists who have each shaped the global dance music landscape in their own way. DJ Snake will also be taking the Sunburn Arena stage in Bengaluru as part of his India tour and we look forward to welcoming fans from across India for an unforgettable edition of Sunburn Festival.”

Tickets for Sunburn Festival 2026 are on sale via BookMyShow, priced from ₹3,500 onwards for single-day passes and ₹7,000 for a season pass.

item.title: Keinemusik’s Adam Port Announces Three-City India Tour in November
item.dc:creator: Anurag Tagat
item.content:encoded:
Berlin collective Keinemusik’s co-founder Adam Port will return to India in November, bringing his acclaimed blend of afro-house to three cities.

Port, who has often eschewed easy categorization that goes beyond afro-house to draw from techno, dub, dancehall, soul and more, will perform in Delhi NCR on Nov. 13, 2026 at NSIC Exhibition Ground, in Kolkata on Nov. 14 at Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan and close in Bengaluru on Nov. 15 at Bhartiya Mall.

The tour, produced and promoted by electronic music festival Sunburn, comes on the back of Keinemusik’s sold-out Mumbai show in March this year. Expect groove-driven, genre-blending sets in each city from the artist who has performed at top stages such as Coachella, Burning Man and Tomorrowland, among others.

Sunburn CEO Karan Singh says in a statement, “Keinemusik’s India debut proved that the country’s electronic music audience isn’t just growing in size, it’s becoming more discerning in what it seeks out. The overwhelming response showed us that fans are following the artists behind the collective just as passionately as the brand itself. Adam Port was one of the standout moments from that experience and the demand to see him return was impossible to ignore. This three-city tour is our way of building on that momentum, giving fans a deeper, more intimate experience while expanding access beyond a single market. It’s another step in strengthening India’s position on the global electronic music touring map.”

The FAMFAM presale tickets for Adam Port’s India tour go live at 5:30 PM on July 29, followed by general sales starting at 5:30 PM on July 30 on BookMyShow. 

Keinemusik presents Adam Port India Tour 2026

Nov. 13, 2026 – NSIC Exhibition Ground, New Delhi

Nov. 14, 2026 – Biswa Bangla Mela Prangan, Kolkata

Nov. 15, 2026 – Bhartiya Mall, Bengaluru
